changes.why: CR-014-8: the …/ note asserted a file was 'outside the project's repository', which is false for the 65 of 140 recorded dispatch-board edits made in a git worktree of the repository. Reworded to say the board could not place the file inside the repository, covering both the worktree case and the genuinely-outside case, without asserting either.

CR-014-9(a): an Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit call was recorded as an edit from its tool_use block alone, before its tool_result was known; a refused or failed call still published the file as edited. Added failed_edit() to note a tool_use id whose tool_result carries is_error, and agent_summary() now drops that id's file. CR-014-9(b): publishable_files() treated a home-relative (~/…) or drive-relative (C:foo) path as a plain relative path, publishing its folders; both are now matched by UNPLACEABLE and withheld as …/<name>, same as a path genuinely outside the repository.
Pin CR-014-8's corrected wording on the AC-82 run-detail check, and assert the old, false-for-worktrees wording is gone.
Add a failing-first test for each CR-014-9 case: a refused/failed edit call is excluded, and a home- or drive-relative path publishes withheld.
